item.title: Driver injured after vehicle strikes moose on Highway 135
item.description: ST. LOUIS COUNTY, Minn. — A driver was injured after a vehicle struck a moose in northern Minnesota. Minnesota State Patrol says a Lincoln Continental was traveling southbound on Highway 135 near Mile Marker 25 when it collided with a moose.
